backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing configurable contact info feature and associated files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing short descriptions of key frontend components and config files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining color variables and theme behavior for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with metadata and script loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component rendering navigation, all sections, and the footer.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer showing copyright and a Caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section presenting company overview and highlight cards.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Contact section showing contact info from config and an inquiry form with validation.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Hero section with background image, headline, CTAs, and key statistics.
frontend/src/components/sections/Project: Renders a projects section displaying a grid of project cards with images, titles, and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Displays a services section showing a set of service cards with icons, titles, and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/TopNav.tsx: Responsive navigation bar with logo, smooth scrolling links, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/config/contactInfo.ts: Exports a contact info configuration object containing phone, email, and address fields.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Provides a hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on the user's identity using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity auth provider and hook for managing login state, identity loading, and logout.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom color variables for the site's construction-themed design system.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, and plugins for the project.
project_state.json: Stores metadata about the project's state, features, requirements, and configuration.
